title: Drill-in report summary is the ticks-worker preamble comment, not the report
body:
reportSummary takes the first non-heading paragraph, and cloud worker reports open with '<!-- ticks-worker: container facts, prepended after the harness exited … -->'. So 11 ticks' drill-in report line (0rx 378 3rc 7uv c2u fq0 lh4 ltg oro zl1 u5n) reads the container preamble rather than what the worker did. Skip HTML comment paragraphs.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/report.go:262-284 (reportSummary); live tick view for 0rx; `ticfac status epic-hn6 --json` .waves[].ticks[].report.summary
